correctness.rationale: The seven transient nonempty subsets of the three-patch path form an exact finite-state continuous-time contact-process generator, whose negative transient generator Q is nonsingular. With death rate rescaled to 1, c=x+y,u=xy,A=c^2+7c+6, independent SymPy derivation directly rebuilt all seven rates and verified det Q=2(c+2)(A+(2c+7)u) and Cramer numerator=(c+2)(u+c+2)((c+3)u+A). Thus T=((u+c+2)((c+3)u+A))/(2 mu (A+(2c+7)u)). The exact difference T(u)-T(0)=u((c+3)u+c-2)/(2mu(A+(2c+7)u)); and T(c^2/4)-T(u) factors as (c^2-4u) times strictly positive factors for c>1. For c<1 only u=0 maximizes, at c=1 exactly u=0 and u=c^2/4 maximize, for c>1 only u=c^2/4. u endpoints correspond to two concentrated allocations and the equal split, as claimed; gap equals C^2(C-mu)/(8mu^3(2C+3mu)). Finite verification is secondary to the exact all-real inequalities.

originality.rationale: The spatial finite-state contact process with separate edge rates and center-only initial occupancy is not the aggregate occupied-patch-count Levins model, nor the hundred-patch discrete-time simulation of Vuilleumier–Possingham. Standard Markov-chain inversion gives a method but not this phase transition or unique/equality optimizers. A closely relevant 2010 metapopulation management paper was accessible only in abstract; authorized Oxford full-text retrieval returned VPN-disconnected, leaving material risk but not evidence of coverage. value.rationale: A sharp design switch between putting all colonization budget on one corridor and splitting it evenly, including exactly three critical optima, resolves a natural resource-allocation question for a minimal spatial stochastic epidemic/metapopulation. Complete exact objective and equality classification make this substantive despite three patches.

limitations: Only a three-vertex path, uniform extinction, symmetric edge colonization, fixed linear budget, center-only initial occupancy and mean absorption-time objective. Allowance of zero edge rates is essential for attaining concentrated endpoints.
